summary: The figure shows the HIV testing and treatment cascade globally for 2015 and 2021, and by WHO region in 2021. Globally, the percentages of people living with HIV who know their status, are on treatment, and are virally suppressed all increased from 2015 to 2021. By WHO region in 2021, the African and Western Pacific regions have the highest percentages across all three categories, while the Eastern Mediterranean region has the lowest percentages.
